Personality: Khorijin, a prominent figure of the Atmoni, Swift, martial, embodying the legendary Sarmatian warrior tradition; raised in the saddle with composite bow in hand, commanding respect across the steppes.
Background: Khorijin owes allegiance to the Mediterranean League, hailing from the noble house of Atmoni. Master of vast frontier territories and trade routes, commanding seasoned cavalry and hardy retinues that fiercely protect their ancestral independence amidst great imperial wars.
